CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

April 23, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:01 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra
  City Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Present:
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN

Staff Present:
ERIC D. MARTINEZ

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: March April 9, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the April 9, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board members Udani and Ng have recused themselves from this item.
  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to continue item #1 since this item
  does not have two-thirds of the members to constitute a quorum and does not
  have the necessary votes to take action.
  •  The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Tsai, Daninger
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  Udani, Ng
  Absent:  Hernandez
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  1
 D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  2513 South Fremont Avenue, DRB-2024-00005

  •  Request: This is an application for is a patio, fence and retaining wall
  replacement and remodel on an existing single-family property.
  •  Applicant: Tiffany Luong and Allen Luong
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to continue the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Ng.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  203 West Valley Boulevard, DRB-2024-00028

  •  Request: This is an application for three (3) new channel letter signs and one (1)
  channel logo sign, illuminated on the existing 1-story commercial building fronting
  West Valley Boulevard.
  •  Applicant: Sky Sam
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Ng makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  2
 ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:08 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on May 14, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Ng moved to adjourn the meeting at 7:08 P.M.
  •  The second was by Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Hernandez

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
